title: Elements Ui App Mode Window Engagement
description: Reimplement Golden Layout-style docking in pure React Mode (tab stacks, resize, drag-dock, maximize, close; no persistence/popout). Restore golden-layout for sketchpad LayoutCanvas.
summary: Refined Mode dock drag preview UX: dragged tab/window pops out as a small floating preview while moving; on valid drop targets the float hides and feedback snaps to the landing spot—tab-only chip + insert line + stack body highlight for tab merges, edge band + compact window preview for splits. Source tab collapses and source body shows placeholder during drag. Fixed same-stack reorder index mapping when the drag source is excluded from tab-bar hit testing (readLayoutAtPath + clamp to shortened stack length). All 47 vitest tests pass; Storybook QuadLayout drag verified merging Detail into Overview tab stack.
